display_name: All 22 sections of Regulation Crowdfunding, encoded de novo from the eCFR
versions_encoded: Part 227 as in force from 2023-03-01 (its latest_amendment_date per the eCFR versioner), read as of 2026-08-03. One `RULES EFFECTIVE DATE` site only (regcf-denovo.l4:223); the module does not answer about earlier versions of the part.
scope: A SECOND, INDEPENDENT encoding of this subject, written de novo from ../../source/ without reading the 'legalese' row, so that registers/surface-map.json can drive a differential between two encodings rather than one encoding against itself. Addresses all 22 sections of the part (§§ 227.100, 201-206, 300-305, 400-404, 501-504); where a section is encoded at reduced surface the reduction is stated at the site. Every quoted string is verbatim from source/part227.txt. registers/ carries the source bundle (retrieved 2026-08-05), the sweep register (no binding modification found), 26 interpretive forks and the surface map. 39 assertions, none failing, with four goldens.

not_reviewed.note: No HG1 grant or waiver was found for this encoding in legalese/l4-ide, where it was written.
